ns2:course.label: Sustainable Earth
ns2:course.description: Provides an introduction to sustainability that explores how today's human societies can endure in the face of global change, ecosystem degradation, and limited resources. Emphasizes the fundamentals of the physical sciences and the scientific method while also exploring the special impact of sustainability challenges on minority cultures in the U.S. Prerequisite: This course is intended for first and second year students.
